gaps.quote: the dominant terms are powers of $p$ below one, and the smallest margin below one is $2^{-181}=2\kappa$ (cited)
gaps.note: The page never lists the dominant terms, never says what a margin below one measures (the paper's g_i, lines 4846-4854, are explicit margins computed from the fixed parameters), and does not say how the margin gives the final exponent 1-kappa. The reader cannot check that every cost term is at most p^{1-2kappa} or that polylog factors then fit under p^kappa; the cited claim stands in for the cost analysis itself.
